flags.why: Thoát y vũ names the striptease performance or activity, not the performer ([dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/thoat-y-vu-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
flags.fix: Delete sense 2; the performance meaning is already covered by sense 1.

flags.why: The common meaning 'to be satisfied; to feel content' is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-tho%E1%BA%A3%20m%C3%A3n)).
flags.fix: Add: satisfied; content — Tôi chưa thoả mãn với kết quả này. = I am not yet satisfied with this result.
